Using a data-driven approach, Super Founders is a "must-read" (Eric Yuan, founder and CEO, Zoom) examination of what differentiates billion-dollar startups from the rest
As a venture capitalist, Ali Tamaseb has amassed perhaps the largest dataset ever on startups. He compared billion-dollar startups with those that failed to make the grade, using 30,000 data points encompassing nearly every factor: number of competitors, market size, the founder's age, their university's ranking, quality of investors, fundraising time, and many, many more.
